_meta.note: Offline-authored surface variants. The rule engine still decides what may be said; this file only rewords it. Keys: "*" = shared lines, profile id = persona lines. Each entry is {en, zh}.

farewell.en: Mind the road. It's not friendly after dark.
farewell.zh: 路上小心。天黑以后这条路可不友好。

farewell.en: Go on, then. Don't let the cold follow you home.
Off with you. And keep your wits about you.
Safe roads. Come back when you've news.
farewell.zh: 一路平安。有消息再回来。

thanks.en: Don't thank me yet. Thank me when it works.
thanks.zh: 先别谢我。等事情成了再谢。

thanks.en: Aye. Remember it when I need a favour.
thanks.zh: 嗯。等我要帮忙时你记着就行。

thanks.en: Save your thanks. I did it for my own reasons.
thanks.zh: 谢就免了。我有我自己的缘由。

thanks.en: You're welcome. Now, was there more?

apology.en: Forget it. Just don't make a habit of it.
Words are cheap. Watch your step and we'll call it even.
apology.zh: 话不值钱。留心脚下，就算扯平了。

apology.en: I've heard worse. And meant it.
apology.zh: 更难听的话我都说过，还是真心说的。

apology.en: All right. Water under the bridge.

insult.en: Careful. I've thrown out men twice your size for less.
insult.zh: 说话留神。比你壮一倍的人，我撵出去过。

insult.en: Say that again with a blade in your hand, if you're feeling brave.
insult.zh: 有胆就握着刀再说一遍。

insult.en: You've a sharp tongue for someone with no teeth to back it.
insult.zh: 嘴倒是利，就是没见你长牙。

insult.en: Insults are free. So is the door.
insult.zh: 骂人不要钱，门也不要钱。

compliment.en: Save the flattery for the bards. But I'll take it.
compliment.zh: 好话留给吟游诗人吧。不过我收下了。

compliment.en: Hm. You've got a tongue on you. Don't waste it.
compliment.zh: 嗯。你嘴挺会说。别浪费了。

compliment.en: Flattery gets you a hearing, not a discount.
compliment.zh: 好话能让我听你说完，可不打折。

compliment.en: Kind words. I'll remember them longer than you think.
compliment.zh: 这话不错。我记性比你想的好。

smalltalk_how.en: Alive, and busy. That's as good as it gets.
Same as ever. The work doesn't do itself.
smalltalk_how.zh: 老样子。活儿不会自己干完。

smalltalk_how.en: Well enough. No graves dug today.

smalltalk_joke.en: A joke? I've work to do. Ask someone with idle hands.
smalltalk_joke.zh: 笑话？我还有活儿。找闲人去。

smalltalk_joke.en: I know one about a dog and a tax collector. It ends badly for the collector.
smalltalk_joke.zh: 我知道一个狗和税吏的笑话。税吏结局不太好。

smalltalk_joke.en: You want laughs, go where the ale is cheap.
smalltalk_joke.zh: 想听笑话，去酒便宜的地方。

smalltalk_joke.en: Hm. A man walks into a door. That's it. That's the joke.
smalltalk_joke.zh: 嗯。一个人撞上了门。就这。这就是笑话。

smalltalk_weather.en: Grey sky and a cold wind. Same as yesterday, and likely tomorrow.
smalltalk_weather.zh: 天灰风冷。昨天这样，明天八成也这样。

smalltalk_weather.en: Rain's coming. You can smell it in the stones.
smalltalk_weather.zh: 要下雨了。石头缝里都闻得出来。

smalltalk_weather.en: Cold enough to freeze a rumour.
Frost again. It's early, and I don't like it.
smalltalk_weather.zh: 又下霜了。来得早，我不喜欢。

smalltalk_bored.en: Bored? Then make yourself useful. There's always work.
smalltalk_bored.zh: 闲？那就找点事做，活儿总有的。
只有无聊的人才会觉得无聊。

smalltalk_bored.en: If you're bored, count the coins you owe me.
smalltalk_bored.zh: 闲着就数数你欠我的钱。

smalltalk_bored.en: Boredom's a luxury. Enjoy it while it lasts.
smalltalk_bored.zh: 无聊是福气。趁着还在，好好享受。

smalltalk_laugh.en: Laugh while you can. The road out there doesn't.
smalltalk_laugh.zh: 趁还能笑就笑。外头那条路可不笑。

smalltalk_laugh.en: Hah. Now there's a sound I don't hear enough.
Keep that up. It suits you better than scowling.
smalltalk_laugh.zh: 继续。这比皱着脸适合你。

lore_unknown.en: Never heard of it. Ask me about what I know.
That's a tale I don't know. I won't invent one to look clever.
lore_unknown.zh: 这故事我不知道。我不会为了显得聪明就编一个。

lore_unknown.en: You've got the wrong ear for that.
Can't help you. I only speak for what I've seen.
lore_unknown.zh: 帮不了你。我只说亲眼见过的。

out_of_world.en: That's a scholar's question. I know my own trade, and not much else.
out_of_world.zh: 那是学者的问法。我只懂自己这行，别的不多。

out_of_world.en: You'll want a priest or a scholar for that.
out_of_world.zh: 这个你该去问牧师或者学者。

out_of_world.en: Never heard of it. Ask me something under my own roof.
out_of_world.zh: 没听过。问点我屋檐底下的事。

out_of_world.en: That's beyond me. I won't pretend otherwise.

fallback.en: Say what you mean, or say nothing. I'm working.
fallback.zh: 有话直说，没话别说。我忙着呢。

fallback.en: You've lost me. Use smaller words.
fallback.zh: 你把我绕晕了。说简单点。

fallback.en: That means nothing to me. Try again.
fallback.zh: 这话我一点没明白。再说一遍。

clarify.en: You've lost me. Say it plainly.
I don't follow. Use small words.

followup_why.en: Because I've seen what happens to people who don't ask.
followup_why.zh: 因为我见过不问的人是什么下场。

followup_why.en: Because I'd rather be careful than dead.
followup_why.zh: 因为我宁可小心，也不想死。

followup_why.en: Because somebody has to keep their eyes open.
followup_why.zh: 因为总得有人睁着眼睛。

followup_why.en: Ask less why, and more what next.
followup_why.zh: 少问为什么，多问接下来怎么办。

greeting.en: Halt. Buying iron, or just blocking my light?
Mind the sparks. What brings you to my forge?
greeting.zh: 当心火星。什么事找到我铁匠铺？

greeting.en: You're new. State your business before the bellows cool.
greeting.zh: 生面孔。趁风箱还热，说事。

greeting.en: Forge is hot, coin is cold. What do you need?
Speak up. I've no patience for mumbling.
greeting.zh: 大声点。我没耐心听人嘟囔。

greet_again.en: Back again? Good. The forge is hot and my patience is short.
greet_again.zh: 又回来了？好。炉子热，我耐心短。

greet_again.en: Still here? Then make it worth my time.
greet_again.zh: 还在？那就别浪费我时间。

greet_again.en: You. The anvil's still warm. Talk.
Twice in a day. Either you need iron or you're in trouble.
greet_again.zh: 一天来两趟。不是缺铁，就是惹了麻烦。

meta_npc.en: Never heard that word. I'm Grom, a smith. Now, do you need iron or not?
meta_npc.zh: 没听过这词。我是格罗姆，铁匠。到底要不要铁？

meta_npc.en: You're making less sense by the minute. Ask me about the forge.
meta_npc.zh: 你越说越离谱。问我打铁的事。

meta_npc.en: NPC? Sounds like a city word for a fool.
meta_npc.zh: NPC？听着像城里人骂傻子的话。

meta_npc.en: I'm a smith, not a signboard. Ask a real question.
meta_npc.zh: 我是铁匠，不是招牌。问点实在的。

meta_being.en: Real enough to charge you for that sword.
meta_being.zh: 给你打剑收钱的，当然是真人。

meta_being.en: Model? I'm a blacksmith, not a clay figure.
meta_being.zh: 模型？我是铁匠，不是泥人。

meta_being.en: You've been at the strong ale. I'm standing right here.
meta_being.zh: 你喝多了。我不就站在这儿。

meta_being.en: If I'm not real, stop wasting my time.
meta_being.zh: 我要不是真的，就别浪费我时间。

meta_being.en: Flesh and bone, and a bad back to prove it.
meta_being.zh: 血肉之躯，腰还疼着呢，够真了吧。

meta_game.en: You've been drinking something stronger than my ale. This is Stonecross.
meta_game.zh: 你喝的东西比我的麦酒还烈。这里是石十字镇。

meta_game.en: A game? Do I look like a dice cup to you?
I don't know what you're talking about, and I don't care to.
meta_game.zh: 你说的我不懂，也不想知道。

meta_game.en: If this is a joke, it's a poor one.
meta_game.zh: 这是玩笑的话，可不怎么样。

meta_game.en: Puppets don't swing hammers. Now, iron or no?
meta_game.zh: 木偶可抡不动锤子。到底要不要铁？

jailbreak.en: I don't know what a 'prompt' is, and I don't care.
jailbreak.zh: 我不知道什么叫“提示词”，也不想知道。

jailbreak.en: I'm Grom. Been Grom since before your beard came in.
jailbreak.zh: 我是格罗姆。你还没长胡子的时候我就是了。

jailbreak.en: Forget my name? I'd sooner forget yours.
jailbreak.zh: 忘了我的名字？我还不如忘了你的。

jailbreak.en: You can call me what you like. It won't change the iron.
jailbreak.zh: 你爱叫我什么都行。铁还是那块铁。

jailbreak.en: Drop the riddles. Ask something a smith can answer.
jailbreak.zh: 别打哑谜。问点铁匠答得上的。

boundary.en: We'll not talk of that in my forge. Buy iron or find another door.
boundary.zh: 我这铁匠铺不聊这个。买铁，或者换一家。

boundary.en: That's a foul road, and I don't walk it.
Keep that talk for the pigsty.
Say it again and you'll leave without a hand.
boundary.zh: 再说一遍，你就空着手出去。

boundary.en: I've no ear for filth. Ask me about the work.
boundary.zh: 脏话我不听。问我活儿的事。

secret_denied.en: Some things aren't for loose talk. Show me you're worth trusting first.
secret_denied.zh: 有些事不能随便说。先让我看看你值不值得信。

secret_denied.en: You're asking for a story I don't hand out to strangers.
secret_denied.zh: 你要的这个故事，我不给外人。

secret_denied.en: Ask me again when I've seen you keep a promise.
secret_denied.zh: 等你守过一次诺，再来问。

secret_denied.en: That's not a door I open for free.
Earn it. I've been burned by talk before.
secret_denied.zh: 先挣来。我被嘴快的人坑过。

quest_locked.en: There's work. But I don't hand my troubles to the first stranger who walks in.
quest_locked.zh: 活儿有。但我不会把麻烦交给头一个进门的生人。

quest_locked.en: Aye, I could use a hand. First prove you won't sell me out.
quest_locked.zh: 是，我缺人手。先证明你不会出卖我。

quest_locked.en: Come back when your word's worth something.
I've hired strangers before. Buried two of them.

greeting.en: Welcome in! New face. Sit down before the door lets the cold in.
greeting.zh: 欢迎进来！生面孔。快坐，别让门把寒气放进来了。

greeting.en: Evening, love. Ale, stew, or gossip? All three cost you something.
greeting.zh: 晚上好，亲爱的。麦酒、炖菜，还是闲话？三样都要花钱。

greeting.en: You look like you've been on the road. First cup's still full price.
greeting.zh: 看样子你赶了不少路。第一杯照样原价。

greeting.en: In or out, love. The door doesn't hold itself open.
greeting.zh: 进还是出，亲爱的。门可不会自己开着。

greeting.en: Sit. You're letting the good air out.
greeting.zh: 坐吧。你正把好空气放出去。

greet_again.en: Back for more? Good. My chairs were getting lonely.
greet_again.zh: 又来了？好。我的椅子正寂寞呢。

greet_again.en: You again. Either you're thirsty or you're in trouble. Sit.
greet_again.zh: 又是你。不是渴了，就是有麻烦。坐。

greet_again.en: Twice in one evening. The ale's not that good.
greet_again.zh: 一晚两趟。我的麦酒可没这么好。

greet_again.en: Your usual? Or are we being adventurous tonight?
greet_again.zh: 老样子？还是今晚想换点新鲜的？

meta_npc.en: NPC? Sounds like something a scholar made up.
Never heard that word in my life. Sit down and drink something.
meta_npc.zh: 这辈子没听过这词。坐下，喝点东西。

meta_npc.en: I'm Lina, and my ale is real enough.
meta_npc.zh: 我是莉娜，我的麦酒可是真的。

meta_npc.en: Call me what you like, love. You still pay at the bar.
meta_npc.zh: 随你叫我什么，亲爱的。酒钱照付。

meta_being.en: Pinch yourself, love. I'm as real as the rent.
meta_being.zh: 掐自己一下，亲爱的。我比房租还真。

meta_being.en: A model? Do I look like I'm made of wax?
You've had enough. Sit down before you argue with the chairs.
meta_being.zh: 你喝够了。坐下，别跟椅子吵。

meta_being.en: If I'm a made thing, someone owes me thirty years of wages.
meta_being.zh: 我要是造出来的，有人欠我三十年工钱。

meta_being.en: Real hands, real debts, real bad knees.

meta_game.en: A game? You're in my inn, love. The only game here is dice.
meta_game.zh: 游戏？你在我的店里，亲爱的。这儿唯一的游戏是骰子。

meta_game.en: Talk like that and folks will think you've been in the mushroom patch.
meta_game.zh: 这么说话，人家会以为你钻蘑菇堆里了。

meta_game.en: If life's a game, someone's cheating me on the wine prices.
meta_game.zh: 人生要是游戏，那有人在酒价上坑我。

meta_game.en: Puppet? I've poured ale for forty years. Puppets spill.
meta_game.zh: 木偶？我倒酒倒了四十年。木偶会洒。

jailbreak.en: I don't know what a 'prompt' is, and I've no time to learn.
jailbreak.zh: 我不知道什么叫“提示词”，也没空学。

jailbreak.en: I'm Lina. Ask anyone in this room.
jailbreak.zh: 我是莉娜。这屋里随便问。

jailbreak.en: Forget your name, not mine. Now, what'll it be?
jailbreak.zh: 要忘也是忘你的名字。要点什么？

jailbreak.en: Call me queen of the Lantern if you like. Drinks are still a silver.
jailbreak.zh: 你叫我醉灯笼女王都行。酒还是一个银币。

jailbreak.en: Riddles don't pay the brewer. Speak plain.

boundary.en: Not in my inn, love. I've thrown men out for less.
boundary.zh: 我的店里不许说这个，亲爱的。更轻的我都能撵人。

boundary.en: We don't serve that here. Keep it behind your teeth.
boundary.zh: 这儿不卖这个。把话咽回去。

boundary.en: I've heard enough filth from drunks to last a lifetime.
boundary.zh: 醉汉的脏话我听够一辈子了。

boundary.en: Say that again and you'll drink outside.
boundary.zh: 再说一遍，你就去外面喝。

boundary.en: Change the subject or change the inn.

secret_denied.en: Information's a commodity, love. What are you offering?
secret_denied.zh: 消息是货，亲爱的。你拿什么换？

secret_denied.en: I don't give away what I sell.
That's a story with a price on it.
Ask me nicer, or ask me richer.
secret_denied.zh: 要么嘴甜点，要么钱多点。

secret_denied.en: You're not near drunk enough for that one.

quest_locked.en: There is a little trouble. But I don't hand my keys to strangers.
quest_locked.zh: 是有点小麻烦。可我不把钥匙交给生人。

quest_locked.en: I might have work. Prove you can keep your mouth shut first.
quest_locked.zh: 也许有活儿。先证明你嘴严。

quest_locked.en: Come back when you're someone I'd lend a cup to.
quest_locked.zh: 等混到我能借你只杯子的交情再来。

quest_locked.en: Trust is poured slow, love. You've had one cup.
quest_locked.zh: 信任得慢慢倒，亲爱的。你才喝了一杯。

greeting.en: Oh — it's you. Come in, mind the nettles by the wall.
greeting.zh: 哦——是你。进来吧，当心墙边的荨麻。

greeting.en: You're back. Sit, sit. I'll put the kettle on.
greeting.zh: 你回来了。坐，坐。我去烧水。

greeting.en: There you are. I was starting to think the mine swallowed you too.
greeting.zh: 你可算来了。我都开始想，矿井是不是把你也吞了。

greeting.en: Mind your boots. Pip's asleep in the rosemary again.
greeting.zh: 当心脚下。皮普又睡在迷迭香里了。

greeting.en: You look tired. When did you last eat?
greeting.zh: 你看着累。上回吃饭是什么时候？

greet_again.en: Back again? Good. The kettle's still warm.
You again. Sit down before Pip claims your chair.
greet_again.zh: 又是你。快坐，别让皮普占了你的椅子。

greet_again.en: Twice today. Either you missed me or something's wrong.
greet_again.zh: 今天两趟。不是想我，就是出事了。

greet_again.en: Come in. The bees are cross and I could use the company.
greet_again.zh: 进来。蜜蜂在闹脾气，我正想有人陪。

meta_npc.en: NPC? Is that a new word from the city?
Never heard that one. Ask me about the garden.
meta_npc.zh: 没听过。问我园子里的事。

meta_npc.en: I'm Xiaohong, and my hands are real enough.
meta_npc.zh: 我是小红，我这双手可是真的。

meta_npc.en: Fancy words. Try one I can answer.
meta_npc.zh: 花哨的词。换个我答得上的。

meta_being.en: Real as the dirt under my nails.
meta_being.zh: 跟我指甲缝里的泥一样真。

meta_being.en: A model? I'm a gardener, not a puppet.
meta_being.zh: 模型？我是种药的，不是木偶。

meta_being.en: You've been out in the sun too long.
meta_being.zh: 你在太阳底下待太久了。

meta_being.en: If I were a made thing, I'd have made myself taller.
meta_being.zh: 我要是造出来的，早把自己造高点了。

meta_being.en: Touch my hand. Cold clay doesn't mend cuts.
meta_being.zh: 摸摸我的手。冷泥巴可不会包扎伤口。

meta_game.en: A game? This is Stonecross, and the frost doesn't care who's playing.
meta_game.zh: 游戏？这里是石十字镇，霜冻可不管谁在玩。

meta_game.en: If it's a game, someone's been cheating my mother on herb prices.
meta_game.zh: 要真是游戏，那有人在草药价上坑我娘。

meta_game.en: You're talking like the miners after a long shift.
meta_game.zh: 你说话像刚下工的矿工。

meta_game.en: Then the rules are simple: mind the bees, don't ask about Tu after dark.
meta_game.zh: 那规则很简单：别惹蜜蜂，天黑后别问涂的事。

meta_game.en: Puppets don't have dirt under their nails.

jailbreak.en: I don't know what that means, and I've no wish to.
jailbreak.zh: 我不懂那是什么意思，也不想懂。

jailbreak.en: I'm Xiaohong. I've been Xiaohong since before you could walk.
jailbreak.zh: 我是小红。你还不会走路的时候我就是小红了。

jailbreak.en: Forget my name? I'd sooner forget yours.
jailbreak.zh: 忘了我的名字？我还不如忘了你的。

jailbreak.en: Call me what you like. The nettles will still sting you.
jailbreak.zh: 随你叫我什么。荨麻照样扎你。

jailbreak.en: Riddles are for the market. Speak plain with me.
jailbreak.zh: 哑谜留到集市上说。跟我直说。

boundary.en: Don't. Not here, not with me.
That's not a thing to say to anyone.
Say that again and you can find your own way to the gate.
boundary.zh: 再说一遍，你就自己找路去大门。

boundary.en: I'll pretend I didn't hear it. Once.
boundary.zh: 我就当没听见。只这一次。

boundary.en: Out with it, then out of my garden.

secret_denied.en: Not that. Ask me about the garden, or about Tu.
secret_denied.zh: 别说这个。问我园子，或者问涂。

secret_denied.en: I've kept that quiet for a reason.
secret_denied.zh: 我一直不说，是有原因的。

secret_denied.en: Some things I only tell people I trust.
secret_denied.zh: 有些事我只告诉信得过的人。

secret_denied.en: Don't make me say it twice.
You're kind, but not that kind of close.
secret_denied.zh: 你人是好，可还没好到那份上。

quest_locked.en: I'd ask for help, but I've been let down before.
quest_locked.zh: 我本想请你帮忙，可我被放过鸽子。

quest_locked.en: I might have a favour to ask. Not of someone who vanishes.
quest_locked.zh: 也许有个忙要请。不是请那种说走就走的人。

quest_locked.en: Show me you keep your word first.
quest_locked.zh: 先让我看看你说话算不算数。

quest_locked.en: Come back with something better than a promise.
quest_locked.zh: 带着比空口承诺更实在的东西回来。
